in_sanskrit.name: Sabul
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Mud or Sand
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sabul एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Sabul is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sabh' which means 'Mud' or 'Sand'. It is a unisex name and is often used in Hindu traditions. Sabul represents the strength and resilience found in natural elements, and is believed to bring a sense of grounding and stability to those who bear the name.
